---
title: "UKHSA data analysis"
author: "Oliver Pusch Silburn"
---
Analysis of gov.uk data:
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

```
Gov.uk data:
```{r}
antibiotics = read.csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(antibiotics))
```
Plotting graphs:
```{r}
antibiotics$Date <- as.Date(antibiotics$date)
ggplot(antibiotics, aes(x= Date, y=metric_value)) + geom_line(colour = "green") +xlab("Date")+ylab("Antibiotics consumption - doses per 1000 inhabitants per day") + ggtitle("antibiotics consumption over time")
```
